description: This file contains Python source code defining classes and functions related to logging and I/O handling within the PySpark framework, including custom stream wrappers, JSON formatting for logs, and context-aware logging utilities.

classes.name: DelegatingTextIOWrapper
classes.description: A TextIO wrapper that delegates all operations to another TextIO object.

classes.name: JSONFormatterWithMarker
classes.description: A custom JSON formatter for logging that adds markers and worker IDs.

classes.name: JsonOutput
classes.description: A TextIO wrapper that outputs logs in JSON format with contextual information.

methods.name: context_provider
methods.description: Provides context information for logging, including caller function and class names.

methods.name: capture_outputs
methods.description: A context manager that captures stdout and stderr, redirecting them to JSON log outputs if a Spark session UUID is present.
